phase: Phase 17-MM-G - GL1800F-internal field error (truncation / omission) as the mismatch truth: MM masquerade test and FE-L / FE-P suppression, redone without the GRGM1200L - GL1800F convention difference
written: 2026-10-15, before any MM-G number was computed (owner request: use GL1800F only)
motivation: MM / FE-L / FE-P used alpha (GRGM1200L - GL1800F) as the mismatch; FE-P showed it is a median 5700 sigma_GL1800F convention-scale difference. The estimator field is GL1800F 50x50; its own physically real model error is the omitted GL1800F content above degree 50

truth_fields.primary_D100: GL1800F 100x100 (C._M[100], same file, mu, R, frame MOON_PA_DE440): omission error = GL1800F degrees 51..100
truth_fields.secondary_D200_linear_only: GL1800F 200x200 loaded from the same file (frame MOON_PA_DE440): omission degrees 51..200; linear only (the propagator is qualified to 100x100)
truth_fields.commission_reference: GL1800F coefficient error at its published sigma (degrees 2..50) is already characterised by FE-P section 3.4; not repeated

estimator: unchanged: KP2 M3, free per-pass Doppler bias, GL1800F 50x50, HIGH_FIDELITY, state prior, range 5 m, Doppler 1e-4 m/s

stage_1_linear.mismatch_column: a(GL1800F to degree D) - a(GL1800F 50x50) along the model trajectory, STM convolution, production range / counted-Doppler partials (the FE-L construction); D in {100, 200}; no alpha scaling (the omission is the real field content)
stage_1_linear.metrics: fv_chi2 (2 dof), data-row residual chi2, under N = 0 (fixed field), FE N = 4, 6 data-only (FE-L analogue) and FE N = 4, 6 with the FE-P x1 GL1800F prior (FE-P analogue); noncentrality is the FE-L / FE-P value (mismatch-independent)
stage_1_linear.linear_masquerade(cell, D): fv_chi2 >= 13.82 AND residual chi2 <= 2 sqrt(2 N_data) under N = 0

gates.L1_same_design: the recomputed GRGM-mismatch column equals the FE-P design h_mm of the same cell within 1e-10 relative (proves the omission columns sit on the FE-P designs)
gates.L2_linearity_D100: CANON k0: convolution position history vs (truth-GL1800F-100 propagation - model propagation), relative <= 2e-2

stage_2_nonlinear.truth: primary_D100, through phase17_mm_experiment._truth_segment (HIGH_FIDELITY dynamics, KP2 HF_TOL)
stage_2_nonlinear.run_set: the 4 MM cells (CANON k0 ci0, O1 k12 ci3, O2 k0 ci4, O5 k0 ci8, the MM seeds, MM baselines reused) PLUS every further cell flagged linear_masquerade(cell, 100) in stage 1 (with a new KP2-T0 baseline job, same seed rule rng([ci, 0, 0])); the set is fixed by the stage-1 rule before any nonlinear run
stage_2_nonlinear.measures: MM measures and thresholds unchanged: chi2_detect >= 13.82; delta_chi2 <= 2 sqrt(2N); runs test reported
outcome_rule: MMG_INCONCLUSIVE if a run that would decide the outcome did not converge (or a gate L1 / L2 fails)
MMG_OMISSION_MASQUERADES if some converged run has chi2_detect >= 13.82 AND delta_chi2 <= 2 sqrt(2N)
MMG_OMISSION_FALSE_VARIATION_DETECTABLE if some converged run has chi2_detect >= 13.82 but every such run has delta_chi2 > 2 sqrt(2N)
MMG_OMISSION_NEGLIGIBLE if no converged run reaches chi2_detect >= 13.82

fe_redo_reporting: for D = 100 and 200 (linear): SUPPRESSES(N, prior) = fv_chi2 < 13.82 in all 10 cells; PRESERVES is mismatch-independent and taken from FE-L (data-only: fails at N = 4, 6) and FE-P (x1 prior: holds). Reported, no new classification is added beyond the stage-2 outcome
not_claimed: that the GL1800F omission is the total real field error (GL1800F itself has commission error and its own omission above its resolved degree)
